name: ruv-x-sgit-pocs
description: sgit vaults + Agent Behaviour Policies inside rUv's agentic stack (POCs)

scripts.poc4:build: mkdir -p out/app/vendor out/app/data && cp poc/poc4-browser/index.html out/app/ && cp node_modules/@ruvector/wasm/pkg/ruvector_wasm.js node_modules/@ruvector/wasm/pkg/ruvector_wasm_bg.wasm out/app/vendor/ && cp abp/examples/ruflo-sparc-swarm.abp.json out/app/data/abp.json && cp out/poc1/report.json out/app/data/report.json
scripts.poc5: mkdir -p out/poc5 && (test -d out/poc5/harness || npx --no-install metaharness rm-agentics --template vertical:agentics --host claude-code --no-darwin --target out/poc5/harness > out/poc5/scaffold.log 2>&1) && node poc/poc5-metaharness-abp/harness-to-abp.mjs out/poc5/harness abp/examples/ruflo-sparc-swarm.abp.json coder out/poc5 > /dev/null && (npx --no-install metaharness score . --json > out/poc5/score.json 2>/dev/null || true)
